purpose: Map the first quarantined utterance records into navigable clusters for search, review, and future consented testimony.
principles: A quote without context is not a record.
Last words are not the highest-value words by default.
Silence and ordinary talk are part of the corpus.

clusters.name: Leaving, home, travel, and going somewhere
clusters.danger: turning symbolic or timing-like language into prophecy

clusters.name: Direct questions and difficult feelings
clusters.danger: false reassurance, avoidance, or forced acceptance

clusters.name: Speech fading, hearing, names, and silence
Presence, visitors, ordinary talk, and room language
clusters.danger: making ordinary talk feel trivial or making visits obligatory

clusters.name: Goodbye, repair, estrangement, permission, and clarity
clusters.danger: coercive scripts, trauma erasure, euphemism confusion
